Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyCooldownHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours must pass before Adrenaline Frenzy can trigger again.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyCombatSpeedBonus_tool: Percentage bonus to attack speed during Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyMoveSpeedBonus_toolti: Percentage bonus to movement speed during Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyStreakThreshold_toolt: Minimum kill streak required to trigger Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyFatigueThreshold_tool: Fatigue level (0-100) above which Adrenaline Frenzy can activate.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyEnduranceThreshold_to: Endurance level (0-100) below which Adrenaline Frenzy can activate.
Sandbox_PK42_EnablePlayerSpeech_tooltip: When disabled, the character will never speak during combat. <LINE> Overrides all speech chance settings.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechCooldown_tooltip: Time (in seconds) between allowed speech instances.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnHitZombie_too: Chance (0-100) to say a line when hitting a zombie. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnKillZombie_to: Chance (0-100) to say a line when killing a zombie. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnKillPlayer_to: Chance (0-100) to say a line when killing another player. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_SpeechChanceOnFrenzyStart_t: Chance (0-100) to say a line when Adrenaline Frenzy activates. <LINE> 0 = Disabled.
Sandbox_PK42_BoredomThresholdHours_toolt: In-game hours without a kill before the character starts gaining stress from boredom.
Sandbox_PK42_AllowFrenzy_tooltip: When enabled, the Adrenaline Frenzy mechanic can trigger during combat.
Sandbox_PK42_EnableFrenzyDamageBonus_too: When enabled, Adrenaline Frenzy grants a bonus to damage dealt.
Sandbox_PK42_EnableFrenzySpeedBonus_tool: When enabled, Adrenaline Frenzy grants bonuses to combat and movement speed.
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillZombie_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing a zombie. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillZombieOnFrenzy_tool: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing a zombie while Adrenaline Frenzy is active. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnKillPlayer_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for killing another player. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRawZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Raw Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRawZombieMeat_toolti: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating raw zombie meat. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat.  <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatCookedZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Cooked Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatCookedZombieMeat_too: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating cooked zombie meat. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRecipeZombieMeat: XP on Eat: Recipe Zombie Meat
Sandbox_PK42_XPOnEatRecipeZombieMeat_too: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for eating zombie meat as part of a recipe. <LINE> Note: Eating Human Meat grants double the Insanity XP values set for zombie meat. <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_OnEatCookedPlayerInfectionC: Chance of getting infected when eating cooked zombie meat if the player is not a psychopath.
Sandbox_PK42_OnEatCookedPsychopathInfect: Chance of getting infected when eating cooked zombie meat if the player is a psychopath.
Sandbox_PK42_EnableXPDailyCap_tooltip: When enabled, the total Insanity XP earned per in-game day is limited by the XP Daily Cap value.
Sandbox_PK42_XPDailyCap_tooltip: Maximum Insanity XP the character can earn per in-game day for each action type. Requires Enable XP Daily Cap to be active. <LINE> Note: This cap is applied over BASE XP values, players can gain more Insanity XP than the cap if they have read a book to boost it.
Sandbox_PK42_ButcheringXP_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of butchering XP awarded for butchering a corpse.
Sandbox_PK42_InsanityXP_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and/or Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of Insanity XP awarded for butchering a corpse. <LINE> Note: XP values are calculated based on the meat quality and amount of meat obtained from the corpse, using the same logic as vanilla butchering skill. <LINE> Increasing this value will significantly increase the amount of Insanity XP gained from butchering.  <LINE> Standard value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_CannibalUnlockThreshold_too: Insanity level required to unlock cannibal trait.
Sandbox_PK42_EnableButcherHookPatch_tool: When enabled, applies a patch that allows using the butchering hook for butchering corpses. <LINE><BHC>Turn it off if you face issues with UI mods. <RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_PK42_ButcherCorpseUnlockLevel_to: Insanity level required to unlock the ability to butcher a corpse.
Sandbox_PK42_SkinCorpseUnlockLevel_toolt: Insanity level required to unlock the ability to skin a corpse.
Sandbox_PK42_CollectBonesUnlockLevel_too: Insanity level required to unlock the ability to collect bones from a corpse.
Sandbox_PK42_HallucinationCeaseLevel_too: Insanity level at which hallucinations stop occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_AudioHallucinationStartingC: Base chance of an audio hallucination occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_IntrusiveThoughtsStartingCh: Base chance of an intrusive thought occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_VisualHallucinationStarting: Base chance of a visual hallucination occurring.
Sandbox_PK42_LaughChance_tooltip: Chance of the character laughing involuntarily.
Sandbox_PK42_VehicleJumpscareChance_tool: Chance of a jumpscare event occurring then exiting a vehicle.
Sandbox_PK42_CannibalAmountThreshold_too: Amount of meat (in units) that must be consumed from human/zombie flesh before the character can be considered a cannibal.
Sandbox_PK42_DisableVisualHal_tooltip: Disables visual hallucinations. <LINE> Due to engine limitations, visual hallucinations may not function correctly in multiplayer.  <LINE> If you encounter issues, enable this option.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyMaxTime_tooltip: Max time that Adrenaline Frenzy can last. After this time, the effect automatically ends.
Sandbox_PK42_BanditsXP_tooltip: <BHC>This option is affected by the Global Multiplier and the Insanity Multiplier. <RGB:1,1,1><LINE> Amount of XP received for killing a Bandit NPC. <LINE> Default value: 1 = 0.25
Sandbox_PK42_SimulateNicotineOnKill_tool: When enabled, the effect of withdrawal is reduced when killing a zombie or another player. <LINE> Reduces stress, even when a smoking player is in withdrawal.
Sandbox_PK42_FrenzyStreakChainMaxTime_to: Maximum time (in minutes) between kills to maintain a kill streak for Adrenaline Frenzy. <LINE> If the time between kills exceeds this value, the kill streak resets and the frenzy effect ends.
Sandbox_PK42_MaxFrenzyDamageBonus_toolti: Maximum damage bonus percentage that can be achieved during Adrenaline Frenzy.
Sandbox_PK42_SBSeparator_tooltip: It does nothing, it's just a separator for better organization of the settings in the menu.
